page.title: Maps of Mayotte
page.lead: Free vector maps of Mayotte: outlines, administrative divisions, relief, lagoon and locator maps. Use them in any project, commercial ones included, without asking.
page.licence: Maps under CC0 1.0 (public domain), with the credit “Source: IGN” for those built on IGN data (see the bottom of the page). Code under MIT-0.
page.sources: Sources: IGN – Admin Express COG 2026, BD TOPO, BD ALTI (Licence Ouverte 2.0); Copernicus Sentinel-2 of 2 September 2025; Natural Earth. Outlines, lagoon and locator maps carry no conditions; the other maps reuse IGN data: credit “Source: IGN” when you reuse them.
page.overlay: All island maps sharing a frame overlay pixel for pixel.
map.silhouette.mayotte.text: Grande-Terre, Petite-Terre and the islets, standard detail.
map.silhouette.mayotte-detailed.text: Traced to within 5 m, for large prints.
map.silhouette.mayotte-simple.text: For an icon or a logo: the smallest islets are left out.
map.silhouette.mayotte-lagoon.text: The island in its lagoon, with the barrier reef.
map.administrative.communes.text: The 17 communes, identified by their INSEE code.
map.administrative.epci.text: The 5 EPCIs, identified by their SIREN.
map.administrative.villages.text: 105 villages and inhabited localities, over the communes.
map.administrative.places.text: 684 places: villages, neighbourhoods, localities, beaches, summits, islets, capes and reefs.
map.physical.relief.text: 100 m elevation bands, up to Mount Bénara (660 m).
map.physical.lagoon.text: Reefs and shallows traced on satellite imagery, detailed version.
